drafts.text:
2 nights until Halloween. Another Lantern Witch episode. 🕯️👇

🕯️ THE LANTERN WITCH, EPISODE 3 🕯️

She chased the stranger through the rain,
past broken bells and churchyard lane.
He turned and smiled, then lost his face,
and left her lantern in his place.

The prompt is in the comments 👇

Poetry by Patrick's Place
drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 10-12s. Second 0: the witch's blue lantern swings straight at the lens in pouring rain, so the first frame is a bright flare in darkness. Then she runs through a foggy churchyard after the coated stranger, he turns under a bell tower, his face melts into smoke, and only her lantern is left glowing on the wet stones.

drafts.title: 🐉 THE DRAGON WHO RUINED THE FEAST
drafts.text:
He only wanted to help with dinner. 😅🐉👇

🐉 THE DRAGON WHO RUINED THE FEAST 🐉

He swore he'd light the oven right,
then sneezed and set the hall alight.
The roast is ash, the cook is mad,
but look how proud, he's never sad.

Prompt: 10s vertical, gothic castle kitchen, a small black dragon sneezes fire onto a roast, the chef screams, the dragon smiles proudly.

Made with Grok Imagine 🎬
Save this prompt and try it 👇

Poetry by Patrick's Place
drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 8-10s. Second 0: a close-up of a tiny black dragon's nose twitching right before a sneeze, then a burst of flame fills the frame. Cut to a candlelit castle kitchen where the roast is charcoal, a furious chef waves a ladle, and the dragon sits up straight with a proud little smile and a puff of smoke.

drafts.title: 🕯️ THE LAST HALLOWEEN AT GRANDMOTHER'S HOUSE
drafts.text:
Some houses keep their people, even after they're gone. 🕯️👇

🕯️ THE LAST HALLOWEEN AT GRANDMOTHER'S HOUSE 🕯️

The porch is dark, the pumpkins old,
the windows thin, the rooms gone cold.
But one small candle still burns bright,
she lights it for us every night.

Made with Grok Imagine 🎬
The prompt is in the comments 👇

Poetry by Patrick's Place
drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 10s, soft and realistic. Second 0: a single candle flickers to life by itself in a dusty window of an empty old house at night. Then the camera drifts through cobwebbed rooms past faded family photos and carved pumpkins, and ends on a translucent old woman smiling as she shields the flame with her hand.
